description:
From ISS-003. shell_syntax.py:391 runs on the raw command from pre_bash.py:234, so a `>` in a heredoc body reads as a redirect. Fix: run command_findings and target_findings on logical lines with heredoc bodies removed; the heredoc redirect target and interpreter heredocs (python3 <<EOF) keep their checks.

Acceptance: cat > /tmp/x.py <<'EOF' with a body line containing `> .agent-discipline.json` passes; cat > .agent-discipline.json <<EOF still blocks; python3 <<EOF writing files still blocks. Tests by adw-test-writer.
title: Strip heredoc bodies before the Bash gate reads commands
